# The four truncated GPT-thread messages, in full

`ai/source/gpt_transcript.pdf` cuts four of the PO's own long messages
with "Show more" markers. He pasted them in full on **2026-08-20**.

**This file is a source. Do not edit it.** Spelling, typos and dictation
artefacts are the PO's and are kept. Cut points in the PDF are marked
`<<< PDF CUT HERE >>>`; everything after that marker had never been read
by any agent on this project.

> ok started a new game, mutliple things that are wrong:

**Reading note.** *"What you buy should make a notif, I know what I
bought/clicked on"* — the second clause contradicts the first. The PO
dictates in French and types fast; read for intent, the intent is
**"what you buy should NOT make a notif"**. Flagged, not silently
corrected.
